label: Scale grid 1 mm (diagnostic)
summary: A grid with a 1 mm tile, to check a model's UVs are at real size. Lines at 1 mm, 100 µm, 10 µm and 1 µm; each length is one colour in every grid.
_comment: Phase19 19.1 scale grid (RD-SP-1 to RD-SP-4). Base color = gen_scalegrid.py: a line's colour is its length in every grid, the background a dark shade of the tile's own colour, four line levels, the finest dim. meters_per_tile is exactly the tag (RD-P19-2). Master Opaque, as the UV grid's; matte so a highlight cannot hide a line.
